facts.business: SG Finserve Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered under Section 45-IA of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, primarily engaged in providing loans and advances to MSMEs, SMEs, and wholesale borrowers.
key_risks: Structural credit gap where more than half of MSME demand remains outside the formal financial system
Credit risk in loan portfolio where certain loans have repayments not received on regular basis (though not overdue more than 90 days)
Forward-looking statements involve inherent risks and uncertainties; actual future results may differ materially
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not granted any loans, or provided guarantee for security to any of its directors or to any other person in whom the director is interested, in accordance with the provisions of Section 185 of the Act nor made investments through more than two layers of investment companies in accordance with the provisions of Section 186 of the Act.
